Textual.textualCharacteristicValue: Bulk cap / hold-up damping for buck input (6.3x5.8mm, 105C limit - derate ripple; consider 125C polymer hybrid for final).
RF LPF shunt (TI LP-EM-CC2340R53 value list: 1.2pF) - topology/values UNVERIFIED, tune with VNA
One 100nF per VDDS pin (pins 6/14/25/30), placed at pin, own GND via (SWRA834A 4.3)
Series DC-block (IFA radiator is DC-shorted to GND): TI ref lists 12pF; function assumed
Bootstrap cap 2.2nF/50V X7R - required value per datasheet pin table
Feed-forward C3: TI recommends 27pF for 3.3V out
Type-3 ripple network CB (TI: C0G/NP0 required); 0603 in TI BOM, 0402 footprint pattern to be aligned at sourcing
Internal cap array used (SWRA834A 3.1.1); pads for tuning only
Optional bus filter (TCAN datasheet 11.1 C10/C11); tune vs EMC results
Input cap per TI LM5164-Q1 datasheet Table 7-1 (2 needed)
6GHz, conducted RF/BLE test only, DNP in production allowed
Pack: 1S Li-ion/LiPo with PCM protection and 10k NTC (103AT-2). Keyed housing prevents reverse insertion. Chemistry/temperature tradeoff in README.
Mating harness assumed: pins 1/4 = VBAT/GND pair, 2/5 = CAN_H/CAN_L pair, 3 = IGN/WAKE, 6 = GND/drain. Automotive-grade alternative: Molex MX150 / TE MQS.
Pin1 VTref, 2 SWDIO, 4 SWCLK, 10 nRESET. Prototype/bring-up header; production programming via TC2030 pads (pads on same nets: TP16..TP19).
2x5 1.27mm SMD shrouded, ARM Cortex Debug pinout (XDS110/J-Link)
Package size assumed 2.0x1.6mm (4-SMD) - CONFIRM against Tai-Saw drawing before layout release.
48MHz +/-5ppm, CL 7pF, ESR 30R (validated in TI ref design, SWRS272F 7.20.3.1)
Recommended LF crystal for BLE sleep-clock accuracy (SWRA834A 3.1.2). Alternative: LF RCOSC, frees DIO3/DIO4.
TCAN allows 0.5% clock error; 40MHz recommended for 5Mbps CAN FD. CL and R51 series resistor to be tuned per TI 'TCAN455x clock guidelines'.
Local suppression sized for centrally-suppressed load dump (ISO16750-2 test B, Us*=58V). Unsuppressed 24V load dump (151-202V) needs an upstream central suppressor.
Fuse must ride through inrush; I2t vs. TVS surge to be validated. Non-AEC-Q200 - replace with 0451001.MRL-AEC variant / Littelfuse 0453 if required.
RF LPF series L (TI ref value 2.8nH)
Ferrite bead 220R@100MHz / 2A (AEC-Q200) between V6P0 and TCAN VSUP; 0R jumper if bead not wanted.
DCDC inductor 10uH REQUIRED (SWRS272F 7.4 note); part is TI ref design 'L1 10uH' - exact MPN to be taken from LP-EM-CC2340R5-Q1 BOM.
LM5164 IPEAK(max)=1.75A < Isat. Footprint shared with XAL6060 series - verify land pattern vs Coilcraft XGL6060 drawing.
1uH, Isat 6.3A/8.8A, DCR<=9mOhm, AEC-Q200 (XGL4020 verified; TI reference uses XGL3520-102MEC)
Default OPEN: module is a bus tap. Close JP1+JP2 for 120R split termination (end-node / bench).

ASSIGNMENT PART 'CC2340R40' NOT FOUND in TI datasheets SWRS272F/SWRS292A; nearest automotive-qualified family member selected. SPI0 mux per SWRS292A: SCLK DIO8(m1), CSN DIO11(m1), POCI DIO12(m1), PICO DIO13(m2).
AEC-Q100 -40..125C, VDDS 1.71-3.8V, 512kB flash / 36kB RAM, QFN32 RHB (SWRS292A)
VIO=3.3V from +3V3 (same domain as CC2340 -> no level shifter). Thermal pad = GND (pin 21).
VSUP 5.5-30V (42V abs), VIO 3.135-5.25V, CANH/L +/-58V, HBM 15kV bus, AEC-Q100
ITERM & TMR left open = default 10% termination / default safety timers (TI datasheet pin table). Not AEC-Q100: documented tradeoff (backup path only).
IN 4.35-10.5V op (26V no-damage), OUT reg 4.4V, VBAT 4.2V, VOVP 10.5V
Standard-level FET chosen; logic-level BUK9Y41-80E has VGS limit 10V < LM74700 gate drive.
80V 41mOhm std-level, VGS +/-20V (LM74700 GATE-ANODE max 15V), LFPAK56, AEC-Q101
EN tied to ANODE (always on). ANODE tolerates -65V: reverse polarity blocked by external FET body-diode + gate off.
Placed at J1, before the choke. Suits 12V and 24V (J1939) buses.
PG unused. 100% mode passes battery voltage when VBATSYS<3.3V (MCU VDDS 1.71-3.8V OK).
0R link / optional ferrite bead (TI ref design 'B1')
VTref sense feed (isolates probe from rail)
RSTN has NO internal pull-up (SWRS292A) -> external 100k (TI ref R1)
DNP: fit ONLY with packs that have no NTC (TI: 10k TS-VSS to keep charging valid)
nWKRQ defaults to internal 3.6V rail (TCAN 8.3.10) -> series R protects MCU DIO (max VDDS+0.3=3.6V); set 16'h0800[19]=1 in firmware
Series link: option for external damping / measurement
Type-3 ripple network RA; RA*CA <= tON*(VIN-VOUT)/20mV (TI Eq.25)
VIN divider top: 36V -> 2.9V (ratio 0.0798); 58V clamp -> 4.6V, limited by R64 (ESD diode current < 1uA)
Geometry reproduced from TI SWRU120D Figure 1-1 / Table 1-1; performance on this stackup is UNVERIFIED.
PCB antenna, gain +3.3dBi max (TI meas., 1mm FR4 ref board)
Land pattern from TDK datasheet 4/25 (5.9 x 3.4 with 3.2 / 1.6 gaps).
